cache.enabled.description: Enable or disable caching of delivery results to improve performance and reduce redundant operations.

cache.max_size.description: Maximum number of delivery results to keep in the cache. Older entries are evicted when exceeded.

cache.ttl.description: Time-to-live for cached entries in seconds. Entries older than this are considered stale.

cache.path.description: Absolute filesystem path where the cache data is stored.

delivery.enabled.description: Enable or disable the delivery service entirely. Disable for maintenance or testing.

delivery.max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent worker processes that can process delivery requests at once.

delivery.max_size.description: Maximum allowed size (in bytes) of a single delivery. Larger requests will be rejected.

delivery.output_path.description: Absolute path to the directory where delivered files are temporarily stored before being sent.

delivery.allowed_hosts.description: Comma-separated list of allowed client hostnames. Empty or omitted means allow all hosts.

delivery.allowed_cidrs.description: Comma-separated list of allowed client IP ranges in CIDR notation. Empty or omitted means allow all IPs.

log.level.description: Minimum severity level for messages to be logged.

log.path.description: Absolute path to the main log file.

log.rotate.description: Enable log rotation to prevent unbounded growth of log files.

log.max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of a log file before it is rotated. Used only if rotation is enabled.

log.max_files.description: Number of old rotated log files to retain. Used only if rotation is enabled.

storage.type.description: Storage backend for persistent delivery state or metadata. Choose 'filesystem' for simple setups or 'database' for scalability.

storage.base_path.description: Base directory used by the filesystem storage backend to store state and metadata.

storage.connection.description: Database connection URI for the database storage backend (e.g., 'postgresql://user:pass@host/db').

storage.compress.description: Compress stored files to save disk space. May increase CPU usage during I/O.
